text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap came by the Trainer's office, 
looking visibly confused about 
something...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I think something's gone wrong with my 
head. This throbbing pain just won't 
stop..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Eat lots of food and you'll cure anything. 
In fact, that's how I've always cured 
myself until now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And yet—ugh! Not again, the throbbing's 
back...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should I eat? For brain 
power... is it head meat, after all?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A sardine head? A whole sea bream head? 
Or eating taiyaki head-first...?!"

"And so, Oguri Cap was troubled by a 
headache..."
